limitations: Ownership discovery covers observed queues/direct holders, not all historical allocations, adapters or cross-chain routes
Internal ownership is relative to selected pilot roots, not all Yearn contracts
Routed attribution uses recorded-debt caps; residual unreported strategy-owned appreciation is not proof of external wallet ownership
Base asset prices are frozen historical quotes; selected share-token underlying is repriced through the child conversion
No future reports, deposits, withdrawals, losses, configuration changes or new accrual beyond scheduled unlocking are assumed
Seven chains screened at blocks no more than 14 seconds before the common timestamp. This is historical research, not a live endpoint.
New-chain price policy requires positive historical quote, confidence >=0.9 and timestamp within 24 hours; missing/rejected prices remain unavailable. Mainnet retains original pilot quotes.
Fantom RPC timestamp overrides unavailable; current conversions checked, all selected schedules exhausted and future model constant.
Known DB cross-chain mappings were revalidated at the pilot blocks; unobserved routes and out-of-scope endpoints still leave this a scoped incomplete pilot.

projection.interpolation: Linear between published timestamps; values are recomputed from frozen external share positions, with base prices and contract state fixed.
